message: ポスター貼りは高等技能
While slapping posters up along the hallway.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Heeey. So the Charity Bazaar ended up being called the 'Ryuusei Academy Sparkle Festival'」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, Sacchin」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yep, I came to help out」

name: Synn
message: 「So, what do you think? Of the name」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I think it's pretty good. Sounds like a department store bargain sale」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That sounds kinda backhanded as a compliment」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're imagining things. Still, this looks rough. You still have this whole pile left」

name: Synn
message: 「If we want it approved at the student assembly, we have to get everyone to know about it first」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Student Council work is surprisingly physical labor, nothing like I imagined」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Are the posters all you're doing?」

name: Synn
message: 「Once we're done putting up posters, we're going to go around to each class and give a quick explanation」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hehehe. In that case, you'd better be super grateful to me too」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, my best friend is working so hard, so I'm pitching in too」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Whoa. Those suspicious eyes. How insulting. I've been telling people all over how hard everyone in the Student Council is working. In other words, I'm the Student Council's fifth column」

name: Synn
message: 「Fifth column?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I don't really get it, but apparently it means a detached force」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Even if I say so myself, I'm doing amazing work. Ahem. I'm gonna keep helping out more and more」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then hey. Could you hand out these flyers at the school gate?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Eeeh, handing flyers to people while they're walking? Asking me to do something that fast is totally impossible」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Then when we go around to the classes, write stuff on the blackboard」

name: Sacchin
message: 「B-But my... handwriting is messy. Your demands are way too advanced」

name: Nanaka
message: 「True...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, what can you even do anyway?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm, nothing for now, I guess. Oh, I know! I'll cheer you on!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you messing with me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, she's offering out of the goodness of her heart」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, what he said!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That doesn't even count as an offer!」
I can't argue with that.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Help me put up these posters. You can at least do that, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehh, I'm just too clumsy for that~」

name: Synn
message: 「That's an old joke」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, I see. I'll be more careful from now on~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「The shelf life of the joke doesn't matter right now. Just put up a poster!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If you insist that much, I guess I have no choice. Don't be disappointed, okay~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Heave-ho, heave-ho. Alley-oop, alley-oop. Phew... and there we go!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「See, I put it up. Whew. Worked up a good sweat~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hate to interrupt your refreshing smile, but this is a bit...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Right? It's crooked, isn't it~ Ahem!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't act proud! Put it up straight!」

name: Synn
message: 「Now, now, Nanaka. She did put it up, after all. And you can still read it just fine」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's not a handwritten poster, of course you can read it! Besides, if it's tilted over 45 degrees, that doesn't count as putting it up!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's impossible. I'm clumsy, you know. I don't have the arm strength to hold the paper in place~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're way too weak!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I've decided it's my loss if I ever carry anything heavier than sweets--」

name: Synn
message: 「No... you've already lost then, Sacchin. Besides, something like a dense, packed chocolate cake is heavier than a poster」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sh-Synn!　Where did you ever carry a chocolate cake?!」

name: Synn
message: 「I carried them when I helped out at a cake shop」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, sweets are measured separately. If it's sweets, any weight is a piece of cake. Ahem」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin, just pretend this poster is a cake!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「No way. I can't eat it--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's paper, so you can eat it if you force yourself. Look, roll it up like this and it's a crepe」

name: Sacchin
message: 「...I wouldn't line up to buy a crepe that looks this gross--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't have to buy it」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin... I hate to say it, but you're way too hopeless」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Gasp」

name: Sacchin
message: 「B-But it's fine. As long as a girl has charm, things work out somehow. It'll definitely maybe kinda-sorta be fine--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. Zero basis for that!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Still, living life really is tough, isn't it. I'm lacking in all sorts of ways, like I can only eat sweets and can't make them...」

name: Synn
message: 「Is that right... You look more domestic than Nanaka, though, Sacchin」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just an illusion. Wait, what do you mean 'than me'!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh, that's the same as Nana-chan. We really are besties, two peas in a pod--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It might be true, and I do sometimes think of Sacchin as a best friend, but don't call us besties over something like that!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Eeeh, I thought we were besties, so hearing it's only 'sometimes' is such a shock. A bolt from the blue. Et tu, Brute--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're just spouting random nonsense, aren't you」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Synn-kun, it's awful. Nana-chan is calling me her enemy--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Jumping straight to enemy now?!」

name: Synn
message: 「That's harsh, Nanaka. Even if it is Sacchin. Calling her your enemy」

name: Nanaka
message: 「When did I suddenly become the bad guy!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're both kinda mean~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「My head hurts... Gah, I'll put them up myself!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Do my share too~ Hooray, hooray, fight, fight~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-b-b-b-b-b-b-bam, bam, b-b-b-b-b-b-b-bam!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa! In no time at all, posters are going up all over the hallway!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, you're amazing~ Clap, clap, clap」

name: Synn
message: 「She's really getting into it」
Posters for the "Sparkle Festival" are filling up one whole wall of the hallway!
I have to do my best too.

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ah, look~, over there~」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way, Nanaka! You can't put up a 'Tenants Wanted' poster for my place!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There are so many of them, nobody's gonna notice if I mix just one in」

name: Synn
message: 「Even Sacchin noticed it, so no way」

name: Nanaka
message: 「There's no point unless I put it up where even Sacchin can notice it, right?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're both so mean~」

name: Synn
message: 「Anyway, no!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Just one is fine, isn't it? Stingy」

name: Synn
message: 「That's not the issue here」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, yeah. Fine, I'll peel this off... Now, onwards we GO!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「B-b-b-b-b-b-b-bam, bam, b-b-b-b-b-b-b-bam!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Could it be~ that Nana-chan is actually pretty suited for the Student Council~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. She's fast and accurate with math, and since she helps keep the ledgers at home, auditing accounts is a piece of cake for her too」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ooh. She's that capable? As her best friend, I'm so proud~」

name: Synn
message: 「Mhm. As her childhood friend, I might be pretty proud too. Still, Sacchin, you should at least be able to put up posters」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe. Sorry~. Still, the power of love really is amazing~」

name: Synn
message: 「The power of love?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, though the power of friendship isn't losing either~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Like I said earlier, I've been secretly and openly spreading the word that this year's Charity Bazaar is going to be amazing~」

name: Synn
message: 「Secretly and openly... Your Japanese sounds kind of broken...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「For example, like: 'Hey, a cute new general store opened up in front of the station, right? Let's totally go sometime~'」

name: Sacchin
message: 「'And on a completely different note, I hear this year's Charity Bazaar is going to be pretty amazing~'」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I casually tack that onto the end of every single conversation~」

name: Synn
message: 「That's insanely unnatural, Sacchin」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I also mention on the side that the Student Council is aiming for a glitzy, thump-thumping, pound-pounding, squelchy-squelchy school life~」

name: Synn
message: 「...It's a sparkling, shining school life」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Still, there's just a tiny little problem~」

name: Synn
message: 「Why's that?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I've been promoting it and all, but just having more items from 'Ponpoko' and 'Raffine' doesn't have enough impact to make it seem way more amazing than usual~」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm. Now that you mention it, maybe so」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I want something catchier that really tugs at a maiden's heartstrings~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Man, this girl sure loves to talk big--take this, grind, grind」

name: Synn
message: 「So fast! You're already done!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Heheh. Leave it to me」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Stop it, Nana-chan! No knuckle-grinding~, it hurts~, I'm gonna die~\s06」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Like hell you'll die!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「My head is super soft so it'll get squished right away~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Is your head made of tofu?! From now on I'm calling you Tofu Girl. Definitely calling you that!」

name: Synn
message: 「Come to think of it, tofu is called something-cake in English, isn't it」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Never mind that, make her stop~, whoa~, I'm dying~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You sound like you've got plenty of energy to spare, though」

name: Sacchin
message: 「You're imagining things. Still, I can't die just yet. Apparently, Sans Souci is putting out a new cheesecake soon. So until I eat it--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ooh! It's finally out?! As the Sweets Club, we must mobilize! Alright, let's head out right now」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ow, that hurt. Okay, I'll let Yumil know too--」

name: Synn
message: 「Nanaka-san. It seems you're forgetting something important」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nothing is more important than Sans Souci's new cheesecake!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Yeah, yeah!」
I silently pointed at the poster.

name: Synn
message: 「Madam Treasurer. Any objections?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「None. Sorry, Synn. The Sweets Club is important, and Sans Souci's new cheesecake is important too, but that's important as well」

name: Synn
message: 「...Sounds kinda like an afterthought」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Haaah... Well, when you're up against delicious sweets, you can't help it--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Maybe so, but I've got my position to think about」

name: Synn
message: 「So if you didn't have your position, sweets would be more important?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「If the bazaar had sweets too, it'd be super fun--」

name: Synn
message: 「That's it! That's it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What is?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin, you're a genius. That's the ticket! How about a cake buffet for Kirafes?!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see! Pay a set fee for all-you-can-eat or something!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Just imagining it makes me feel all happy--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You actually say something smart once in a while, Sacchin! Alright, we gotta go recruit in the shopping district right away」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe. Am I amazing--?」

name: Synn
message: 「Amazing, amazing」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Of course I am. I'm Nana-chan's best friend, after all--」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah. Right now, I really feel like Sacchin is my best friend. My best friend!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sacchin」
The two of them hug each other tightly in the hallway.

name: Synn
message: 「Mm-hmm. Isn't getting along a wonderful thing」

name: Sacchin
message: 「All right! I'm gonna go advertise like crazy that the upcoming Charity Bazaar has all-you-can-eat sweets」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I'll do my best for the sake of sweets! No time to lose!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin ran off even though nothing's been decided yet... Actually, that's the first time I've ever seen her run」
So she can run, that girl.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, even if Sacchin's a little slow on the uptake, of course she can run」

name: Synn
message: 「Fair enough」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's actually pretty fast when she runs. Thing is, though...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ah, she tripped」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ow-ow-ow, but... for the sake of sweets!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see... She can run, she just trips a lot...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well... yeah」

name: Synn
message: 「If we incorporate this idea, things are gonna get super lively! We have to get everyone's approval to hold 'KiraFes' no matter what!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh! Everything for the sake of sweets!」

name: Synn
message: 「No, that's not it...」
